description.text:
UK & Europe leader for business growth and wins. Extended responsibility as Chief Architect, Aviva, AI Strategy Advisor, HSBC

• Lead presales solutions, RFP responses, PoCs, pilots towards business and revenue growth, evolve transformation roadmaps
• Base account mining & proactive proposals, oversee engineering risks, selection & implementation of right technologies and futuristic AI Infused IT Enterprises 
• Joint GTM strategies with Capco, AWS, Databricks, Intel, Wipro Consulting, Cloud & AI labs, conduct Due Diligence, Vibe coding
• Understand Data Engineering challenges, advise on solutions for Data migration, ETL and ML Solution, Data Governance strategies, legacy solutions (Oracle to Cloud)
• Setup Landing Zones (AWS, Azure), Global DR with high availability and low latency, Observability
• Major business wins over $1B (2024-26): Insurance (Aviva, LV, Canada life, Munich Re, Phoenix),  Banking (HSBS, Aldermore, Close Brothers), Daimler, Rebell, Booking.com, NHS

As 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐞𝐟 𝐀𝐫𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐭 & 𝐂𝐓𝐎,  𝐀𝐯𝐢𝐯𝐚, lead Transformation of Group protection, Annuities, Wealth, Home Finance systems towards enabling 2028 vision of 2X customers: 
  - Agentic AI E-to-E policy servicing
  - IVA, Chatbot automation
  - Complaints Multi-agent solution
  - Transfer In / Out Process RPA Automation 
  - AML & Document Fraud Solution

Results include: 
  - 60% savings overall, 20P NPS raise
  - 10X less regulatory escalations
  - 90% less errors over manual & OCR process
  - Security exposures 300 to <5 pm
  - Re-engineering of Portals, Omni-Channel, underwriting, campaign & case mgmt., CRM capabilities – 15M Pension, 17M GI, 3M Wealth customers

  
As AI Strategy Advisor to CTO & Directors of Engineering on modernization, Agentification (HSBC)   
  - Open Banking Modernization, Pricing Transformation, Unsecured Lending
  - Delivered Camunda platform, MF to AWS AI-enabled migration (DB2 to PostGresql, COBOL to Sprintboot)
  - Pilots for Collections & Global Onboarding

Ownership of Business journeys re-imagination and re-architecture of Cynergy Bank’s modernization, SaaS Adoption & Cloud Migration. Relaunched the Bank with 1M customer base

  - Tech evaluation approvals for tech stack and cloud strategy (GCP)
  - EDA architecture, OneSpan Authentication
  - Eurobase (regulatory), nCino
  - Legacy to SaaS and Cloud Migration (Oracle to Postgresql, Equation to Mambu) 
  - MS D365 + Salesforce for CRM
  - Influenced leadership board to replace Mambu with Temenos, adopt BIAN, conduct phased rollout, and multi-region Active-Active deployment
  - Co-chair for Bank TDA board for review and approval of technology solutions, Cybersecurity and vendor services

Key Results: 
  - On schedule launch of 100% Digital Bank with API First & Low Code, Zero Trust Architecture (First phase overcoming Covid challenges)
  - Achieved 99.99% availability, 10k concurrent customers, zero data loss, 1050 points threat pass (3rd Party Cyber Risk Assessment)
  - On time migration of CRM from Salesforce to MS Dynamics, nCino (Origination). Migration of Core Banking to Temenos
  - Architected and implemented UK & Europe Regulatory system requirements, Payments (Bacs, CHAPS, FPS), KYC, AML, GDPR, PCI DSS for Debit and Credit Cards- meeting high availability and low latency requirements 
  - Created and implemented Data Engineering and Data Governance model for the bank: Data migration and ingestion from legacy systems (batch, file and stream), ETL and Data warehousing, Data Marts – Kafka, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, GKE, Looker, GCP DNS,  
  - Security and Deployment architecture with high availability and cross region replication aligned to GDPR
  - Design of DMZ, SSO, Load Balancing, NFRs, Combined Observability, High Availability, Multi-region Disaster Recovery

description.text:
Ownership of Solutions in Cloud Native Architecture, Cloud Migrations, Business Transformations, Cyber Security Solutions Delivery 

• Setup IBM’s Global Cloud Practice. Advisor for client CIOs towards strategic planning and migration strategies
• Lead Cloud Migrations, Journey to Cloud solutions: On-premises to IBM Cloud, IBM Cloud to AWS and Azure. Lift & Shift, Re-architecture and PaaS migrations for BP Global, HDFC Bank, AT&T USA, Dixons UK, L&G UK   
• Data Architectures & Data Pipelines delivered in AWS Glue, Synapse Analytics, DataBricks, Spark, Snowflakes, EMR, Redshift, Power BI
• Due Diligence, Requirement gathering, Target Journeys and Cloud Adoption models for multiple clients
• PoCs for AI models (Python and Libraries) and Statistical modeling for initializing AI benefits - as part of pre-sales, RFPs and proactive accounts growth activities 
• Responsible for developing enterprise customer cloud solutions - enabling the development, migration, modernisation
• Business-oriented cyber risk assessment, Analysis of cyber security controls, Security Road map design, development, costing

description.text: Leader of Architecture, Development & Service Operations of India’s largest Digital Telco Network with 300+ M customers. Led the Business proposal and Master Integrator partnership RFP, by working with the CIO, evolved and implemented 4G Digital Solutions across India: from Business strategy through architecture, DevOps delivery and ITIL aligned service operations, with Pan-India launch in record time

Solution and implementation of Global Operations & Service Operations of Business Analytics platform for Vodafone across 19 countries. Led Solution Architects in various disciplines to evolve ETL Solution Baselines: Hadoop, Ab Initio and Teradata based solution

End-to-end design, implementation and Service Management of Billing platform for UK’s leading Telecom Provider. Managed Operations, End-customer base enhancement for O2. Customer Fan base increase by 50% in 2011, with reduction of Average Daily Billing Rate of IBM by 100%

Service Management & Service Delivery for Entire AT&T OSS Framework with 100+ team of Application Support Managers, Problem Management Tier 1.5 team, Production DBAs, Release Managers, Help Desk in US and India. Recovery of troubled Service Delivery Portfolio with 24x7 Support Requirements. Stabilized with Knowledge base enhancement, 360-degree backup plan, follow-the sun model of uninterrupted
Solution Architecture for Fujitsu's Business Intelligence Core deployment with Websphere, Weblogic, EJB
